<section id="thesis" class="reveal" data-scene="roads" data-video="">
  <div class="section-head"><div><div class="section-kicker">04 / Research</div><h2 class="section-title">Current Thesis</h2></div></div>
  <div class="feature">
    <div class="pill">M.SC. GEOINFORMATICS • MAVAL &amp; MAHABALESHWAR</div>
    <h3>GeoAI Framework for Automated Rural Road Extraction in the Complex Rural Landscapes of Maval and Mahabaleshwar Talukas, Maharashtra, India</h3>
    <p class="muted">Rural roads are vital for connectivity and regional development, but they are hard to map automatically from satellite imagery: they are narrow, winding, often broken up and partly hidden by vegetation and terrain.</p>
    <p class="muted">This research develops a GeoAI framework that uses deep learning and remote sensing to extract rural road networks automatically. It evaluates how well the framework performs in two contrasting landscapes, the flatter rural terrain of Maval and the hilly, complex terrain of Mahabaleshwar, and examines how the rural road networks in both talukas have changed over time.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="sar" class="reveal" data-scene="radar" data-video="">
  <div class="section-head"><div><div class="section-kicker">05 / Advanced Remote Sensing</div><h2 class="section-title">Multi-Temporal SAR Crop Mapping</h2></div></div>
  <div class="feature">
    <div class="pill">ASSIGNMENT WORKFLOW • PUBLIC WEB PUBLICATION</div>
    <h3>Development, Validation and Web Publication of a Multi-Temporal SAR-Based Crop-Type Map</h3>
    <p class="muted">The assignment requires an independent agricultural study, multi-temporal SAR imagery, supervised machine learning, independent validation, uncertainty interpretation and a public interactive webpage. The webpage is designed around those requirements.</p>
    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step"><b>01</b><br>Research question + study area + crop calendar</div>
      <div class="step"><b>02</b><br>Sentinel-1 time series + preprocessing</div>
      <div class="step"><b>03</b><br>VV/VH features + temporal signatures</div>
      <div class="step"><b>04</b><br>Training + independent validation + classifier</div>
      <div class="step"><b>05</b><br>Crop map + accuracy + area + web publication</div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid2" style="margin-top:18px">
      <div class="card"><h3>Required outputs</h3><p class="muted">Interactive crop map, readable legend, study-area context, data and processing summary, training/validation explanation, confusion matrix, overall and class-wise accuracy, crop-area statistics, temporal-signature visualization and limitations.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Responsible interpretation</h3><p class="muted">The map should not be treated as perfectly certain. Important limitations include mixed pixels, small/fragmented fields, similar phenology, incomplete reference data, rainfall or soil-moisture effects, terrain, incidence angle and temporal gaps.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

  const phrase=phrases[pi];
  typed.textContent=deleting ? phrase.slice(0,ci--) : phrase.slice(0,ci++);
  if(!deleting && ci>phrase.length+5) deleting=true;
  if(deleting && ci<0){deleting=false;pi=(pi+1)%phrases.length;ci=0;}
  setTimeout(typeLoop,deleting?45:70);
}
typeLoop();



const observer=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add("show")}),{threshold:.08});
document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(x=>observer.observe(x));

search.addEventListener("input",apply);
document.querySelectorAll(".filter").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{document.querySelectorAll(".filter").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));b.classList.add("active");current=b.dataset.filter;apply();}));

addEventListener("scroll",()=>{const h=document.documentElement;document.getElementById("progress").style.width=(h.scrollTop/(h.scrollHeight-h.clientHeight)*100)+"%";});

<script>
/* ===== Section-aware animated backgrounds =====
   Every section with data-scene="..." gets its own animated background.
   Add data-video="videos/your-clip.mp4" to a section to play a real video there instead
   (the animation stays underneath as a fallback if the file is missing). */
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("canvas"), ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const reduceMotion = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5);
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  const mouse = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0, px: -9999, py: -9999 };
  const ripples = [];

  const PALETTES = {
    dark:  { a: [85, 230, 173], b: [57, 182, 255], c: [213, 255, 91] },
    light: { a: [16, 140, 98],  b: [22, 110, 180], c: [110, 135, 0] }
  };
  let P = PALETTES.dark;
  const rgba = (c, a) => `rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},${Math.max(0, a)})`;
  const rng = seed => () => { seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

  /* ---------- Scenes ---------- */
  const SCENES = {
    orbit: {
      label: "Orbit view",
      init() {
        const r = rng(7), n = 760; this.pts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const y = 1 - 2 * (i + .5) / n, rad = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y), th = i * 2.399963;
          this.pts.push([Math.cos(th) * rad, y, Math.sin(th) * rad, r()]);
        }
      },
      draw(t, al) {
        const R = Math.min(W, H) * .34;
        const cx = W * (W > H ? .72 : .5) + mouse.x * 34 * DPR, cy = H * .55 + mouse.y * 22 * DPR;
        const rot = t * .12 + mouse.x * .5, tilt = .35 + mouse.y * .18;
        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * .3, cx, cy, R * 1.6);
        g.addColorStop(0, rgba(P.a, .10 * al)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(P.a, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        const cr = Math.cos(rot), sr = Math.sin(rot), ct = Math.cos(tilt), st = Math.sin(tilt);
        for (const p of this.pts) {
          const x = p[0] * cr - p[2] * sr, z = p[0] * sr + p[2] * cr;
          const y2 = p[1] * ct - z * st, z2 = p[1] * st + z * ct;
          if (z2 < -.1) continue;
          const s = (z2 + 1) / 2, d = (1.1 + 1.8 * s) * DPR;
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(p[3] > .84 ? P.b : P.a, (.12 + .62 * s) * al);
          ctx.fillRect(cx + x * R, cy + y2 * R, d, d);
        }
        // orbit track + satellite with swath
        const rx = R * 1.4, ry = R * .42, ang = -.35, ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);
        ctx.lineWidth = DPR; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.b, .32 * al);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, ang, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
        for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
          const a = t * .45 - k * .035, px = Math.cos(a) * rx, py = Math.sin(a) * ry;
          const sx = cx + px * ca - py * sa, sy = cy + px * sa + py * ca;
          const behind = Math.sin(a) < 0 && Math.hypot(sx - cx, sy - cy) < R;
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(P.c, (k === 0 ? .95 : .5 * (1 - k / 14)) * al * (behind ? .25 : 1));
          const d = (k === 0 ? 5 : 2.4) * DPR; ctx.fillRect(sx - d / 2, sy - d / 2, d, d);
          if (k === 0 && !behind) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.c, .22 * al); ctx.setLineDash([3 * DPR, 5 * DPR]);
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.lineTo(cx + (sx - cx) * .72, cy + (sy - cy) * .72); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
          }
        }
      }
    },

    contours: {
      label: "Topographic relief",
      init() {
        const r = rng(21); this.peaks = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) this.peaks.push({ x: r() * W, y: r() * H, rings: 7 + (r() * 6 | 0), gap: (26 + r() * 20) * DPR, ph: r() * TAU, depth: .4 + r() });
      },
      draw(t, al) {
        ctx.lineWidth = DPR;
        for (const pk of this.peaks) {
          const ox = pk.x + mouse.x * 26 * DPR * pk.depth, oy = pk.y + mouse.y * 18 * DPR * pk.depth;
          for (let k = 1; k <= pk.rings; k++) {
            const r0 = k * pk.gap, index = k % 5 === 0;
            ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(index ? P.a : P.b, (index ? .5 : .26) * al * (1 - k / (pk.rings + 3)));
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i <= 80; i++) {
              const th = i / 80 * TAU;
              const rr = r0 * (1 + .09 * Math.sin(3 * th + t * .25 + pk.ph + k * .3) + .05 * Math.sin(5 * th - t * .18 + k * .5));
              const x = ox + Math.cos(th) * rr, y = oy + Math.sin(th) * rr * .8;
              i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(P.c, .55 * al); ctx.fillRect(ox - 2 * DPR, oy - 2 * DPR, 4 * DPR, 4 * DPR);
        }
      }
    },

    network: {
      label: "Spatial network",
      init() {
        const r = rng(3), n = Math.round(Math.min(90, W * H / (22000 * DPR * DPR)));
        this.pts = Array.from({ length: n }, () => ({ x: r() * W, y: r() * H, vx: (r() - .5) * 18 * DPR, vy: (r() - .5) * 18 * DPR }));
      },
      draw(t, al, dt) {
        const pts = this.pts, lim = 140 * DPR;
        for (const p of pts) {
          p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
          if (p.x < 0 || p.x > W) p.vx *= -1; if (p.y < 0 || p.y > H) p.vy *= -1;
        }
        ctx.lineWidth = DPR;
        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
          const a = pts[i];
          for (let j = i + 1; j < pts.length; j++) {
            const b = pts[j], d = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
            if (d < lim) { ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.a, .18 * (1 - d / lim) * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke(); }
          }
          const dm = Math.hypot(a.x - mouse.px, a.y - mouse.py);
          if (dm < lim * 1.6) { ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.c, .45 * (1 - dm / (lim * 1.6)) * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.px, mouse.py); ctx.stroke(); }
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(P.a, .6 * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, 1.8 * DPR, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        }
      }
    },

    digitize: {
      label: "Parcel digitizing",
      init() {
        const r = rng(11), cell = 130 * DPR;
        const cols = Math.ceil(W / cell) + 1, rows = Math.ceil(H / cell) + 1;
        const v = [];
        for (let j = 0; j <= rows; j++) { v[j] = []; for (let i = 0; i <= cols; i++) v[j][i] = [i * cell + (r() - .5) * cell * .55, j * cell + (r() - .5) * cell * .55]; }
        this.cells = [];
        for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
          const q = [v[j][i], v[j][i + 1], v[j + 1][i + 1], v[j + 1][i]];
          this.cells.push({ q, cx: (q[0][0] + q[2][0]) / 2, cls: (r() * 3) | 0 });
        }
      },
      draw(t, al) {
        const cyc = 11, sweep = ((t % cyc) / cyc) * (W * 1.25) - W * .1;
        const cls = [P.a, P.b, P.c];
        ctx.lineWidth = DPR;
        for (const c of this.cells) {
          const done = c.cx < sweep, col = cls[c.cls];
          ctx.beginPath(); c.q.forEach((p, i) => i ? ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : ctx.moveTo(p[0], p[1])); ctx.closePath();
          if (done) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba(col, .07 * al); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(col, .38 * al); }
          else ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.a, .06 * al);
          ctx.stroke();
          if (done) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba(col, .6 * al); for (const p of c.q) ctx.fillRect(p[0] - 1.5 * DPR, p[1] - 1.5 * DPR, 3 * DPR, 3 * DPR); }
        }
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(sweep - 90 * DPR, 0, sweep, 0);
        g.addColorStop(0, rgba(P.c, 0)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(P.c, .12 * al));
        ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(sweep - 90 * DPR, 0, 90 * DPR, H);
        ctx.fillStyle = rgba(P.c, .5 * al); ctx.fillRect(sweep, 0, DPR, H);
        // cursor crosshair follows the pointer
        if (mouse.px > 0) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.c, .5 * al); ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(mouse.px - 14 * DPR, mouse.py); ctx.lineTo(mouse.px + 14 * DPR, mouse.py);
          ctx.moveTo(mouse.px, mouse.py - 14 * DPR); ctx.lineTo(mouse.px, mouse.py + 14 * DPR); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    },

    roads: {
      label: "Rural road extraction",
      init() {
        const r = rng(42); this.roads = [];
        for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) {
          const edge = k % 4;
          let x = edge === 0 ? 0 : edge === 1 ? W : r() * W, y = edge === 2 ? 0 : edge === 3 ? H : r() * H;
          let a = Math.atan2(H / 2 - y, W / 2 - x) + (r() - .5) * .9, turn = 0;
          const pts = [[x, y]]; let len = 0; const cum = [0];
          for (let s = 0; s < 160; s++) {
            turn = turn * .85 + (r() - .5) * .22; a += turn;
            const nx = x + Math.cos(a) * 16 * DPR, ny = y + Math.sin(a) * 16 * DPR;
            len += Math.hypot(nx - x, ny - y); x = nx; y = ny; pts.push([x, y]); cum.push(len);
            if (x < -40 || x > W + 40 || y < -40 || y > H + 40) break;
          }
          this.roads.push({ pts, cum, len, delay: k * .6 });
        }
      },
      draw(t, al) {
        SCENES.contours.draw(t, al * .45);
        const cyc = 14, tt = t % cyc;
        for (const rd of this.roads) {
          const f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (tt - rd.delay) / 7)), stop = f * rd.len;
          if (stop <= 0) continue;
          ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.lineJoin = "round";
          let head = rd.pts[0];
          for (const pass of [[P.b, .12, 9], [P.c, .7, 1.8]]) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(pass[0], pass[1] * al); ctx.lineWidth = pass[2] * DPR;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rd.pts[0][0], rd.pts[0][1]);
            for (let i = 1; i < rd.pts.length && rd.cum[i] <= stop; i++) { ctx.lineTo(rd.pts[i][0], rd.pts[i][1]); head = rd.pts[i]; }
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          if (f < 1) { // detection box travelling with the extraction front
            const s = 16 * DPR; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.a, .8 * al); ctx.lineWidth = DPR;
            ctx.strokeRect(head[0] - s / 2, head[1] - s / 2, s, s);
          }
        }
        ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      }
    },

    radar: {
      label: "SAR time series",
      init() {
        const r = rng(5), cw = 92 * DPR, ch = 58 * DPR; this.fields = [];
        for (let y = -H * .3; y < H * 1.3; y += ch) for (let x = -W * .3; x < W * 1.3; x += cw)
          this.fields.push({ x, y, w: cw * (.7 + r() * .28), h: ch * (.7 + r() * .25), crop: (r() * 3) | 0, ph: r() * TAU });
      },
      draw(t, al) {
        const crops = [P.a, P.c, P.b];
        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(W / 2 + mouse.x * 20 * DPR, H / 2 + mouse.y * 14 * DPR); ctx.rotate(-.14); ctx.translate(-W / 2, -H / 2);
        for (const f of this.fields) {
          const grow = .5 + .5 * Math.sin(t * .35 + f.ph + f.crop * 2.1); // crop phenology through the season
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(crops[f.crop], (.03 + .11 * grow) * al); ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.w, f.h);
          ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(crops[f.crop], .10 * al); ctx.lineWidth = DPR; ctx.strokeRect(f.x, f.y, f.w, f.h);
        }
        ctx.restore();
        // speckle
        ctx.fillStyle = rgba(P.a, .16 * al);
        for (let i = 0; i < 260; i++) ctx.fillRect(Math.random() * W, Math.random() * H, DPR * 1.3, DPR * 1.3);
        // range rings and sweep
        const ox = W * .82, oy = H * .78, L = Math.hypot(W, H);
        ctx.lineWidth = DPR;
        for (let k = 1; k < 7; k++) { ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.b, .1 * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox, oy, k * 150 * DPR, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke(); }
        const ang = t * .55;
        for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
          const a = ang - i * .018; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.a, .26 * (1 - i / 26) * al);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox, oy); ctx.lineTo(ox + Math.cos(a) * L, oy + Math.sin(a) * L); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    },

    pins: {
      label: "Map explorer",
      init() {
        const r = rng(99); this.pins = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) this.pins.push({ x: (.08 + r() * .84) * W, y: (.12 + r() * .76) * H, ph: r() * 3 });
      },
      draw(t, al) {
        const cell = 90 * DPR, ox = (t * 10 * DPR + mouse.x * 30 * DPR) % cell, oy = (t * 5 * DPR + mouse.y * 20 * DPR) % cell;
        ctx.lineWidth = DPR; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.a, .07 * al); ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = -cell + ox; x < W + cell; x += cell) { ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); }
        for (let y = -cell + oy; y < H + cell; y += cell) { ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); }
        ctx.stroke();
        const pins = this.pins;
        for (let i = 0; i < pins.length; i++) {
          const a = pins[i], b = pins[(i + 3) % pins.length];
          const mx = (a.x + b.x) / 2, my = Math.min(a.y, b.y) - Math.abs(a.x - b.x) * .25;
          ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.b, .18 * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(mx, my, b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke();
          const u = (t * .22 + i * .31) % 1, iu = 1 - u;
          const qx = iu * iu * a.x + 2 * iu * u * mx + u * u * b.x, qy = iu * iu * a.y + 2 * iu * u * my + u * u * b.y;
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(P.c, .8 * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(qx, qy, 2.2 * DPR, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        }
        for (const p of pins) {
          const near = Math.hypot(p.x - mouse.px, p.y - mouse.py) < 120 * DPR;
          for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            const ph = ((t + p.ph + k * 1.2) % 2.4) / 2.4;
            ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(P.a, (near ? .7 : .4) * (1 - ph) * al);
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, (4 + ph * (near ? 46 : 30)) * DPR, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = rgba(near ? P.c : P.a, .9 * al); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.4 * DPR, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        }
      }
    }
  };

  /* ---------- Engine ---------- */
  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = Math.round(innerWidth * DPR); H = canvas.height = Math.round(innerHeight * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = innerWidth + "px"; canvas.style.height = innerHeight + "px";
    for (const k in SCENES) SCENES[k].init();
  }
  let cur = "orbit", prev = null, blend = 1, time = 0, last = performance.now(), paused = reduceMotion;

  function drawRipples(now) {
    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const rp = ripples[i], age = (now - rp.t0) / 1000;
      if (age > 1.6) { ripples.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const a = age - k * .14; if (a < 0) continue;
        ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(k ? P.b : P.c, .55 * (1 - a / 1.6)); ctx.lineWidth = 1.4 * DPR;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rp.x, rp.y, a * 240 * DPR, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
    const step = paused ? 0 : dt; time += step;
    mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * .05; mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * .05;
    blend = Math.min(1, blend + dt / .9);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (prev && blend < 1) SCENES[prev].draw(time, 1 - blend, step);
    SCENES[cur].draw(time, blend, step);
    drawRipples(now);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  /* ---------- Optional real videos per section ---------- */
  const videoWrap = document.getElementById("bgVideos"), videos = {};
  function showVideo(id) {
    for (const k in videos) {
      const v = videos[k];
      if (k === id) {
        if (!v.src) v.src = v.dataset.src;
        const p = v.play(); if (p) p.catch(() => {});
      } else { v.classList.remove("on"); setTimeout(() => { if (!v.classList.contains("on")) v.pause(); }, 900); }
    }
  }

  /* ---------- Sections, HUD, dots ---------- */
  const sections = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-scene]")];
  const hudName = document.getElementById("sceneName"), dots = document.getElementById("sceneDots");
  sections.forEach(sec => {
    const title = sec.id === "top" ? "Home" : (sec.querySelector("h2")?.textContent.trim() || sec.id);
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button"; b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Go to " + title);
    b.innerHTML = `<span>${title}</span>`;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => sec.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth" }));
    dots.appendChild(b); sec._dot = b;
    if (sec.dataset.video) {
      const v = document.createElement("video");
      Object.assign(v, { muted: true, loop: true, playsInline: true, preload: "none" });
      v.dataset.src = sec.dataset.video; v.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      v.addEventListener("playing", () => { if (activeId === sec.id) v.classList.add("on"); });
      v.addEventListener("error", () => { v.remove(); delete videos[sec.id]; });
      videoWrap.appendChild(v); videos[sec.id] = v;
    }
  });
  let activeId = null;
  function activate(sec) {
    if (sec.id === activeId) return;
    activeId = sec.id;
    const next = SCENES[sec.dataset.scene] ? sec.dataset.scene : "network";
    if (next !== cur) { prev = cur; cur = next; blend = reduceMotion ? 1 : 0; }
    hudName.textContent = SCENES[cur].label;
    sections.forEach(s => s._dot.classList.toggle("active", s === sec));
    showVideo(sec.id);
  }
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) activate(e.target); }), { rootMargin: "-45% 0px -50% 0px" });
  sections.forEach(s => io.observe(s));

  const pauseBtn = document.getElementById("motionBtn");
  function syncPause() {
    pauseBtn.textContent = paused ? "▶ Play" : "❚❚ Pause";
    pauseBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(paused));
    Object.values(videos).forEach(v => paused ? v.pause() : (v.classList.contains("on") && v.play().catch(() => {})));
  }
  pauseBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { paused = !paused; syncPause(); });
  syncPause();

  addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    mouse.tx = e.clientX / innerWidth * 2 - 1; mouse.ty = e.clientY / innerHeight * 2 - 1;
    mouse.px = e.clientX * DPR; mouse.py = e.clientY * DPR;
  }, { passive: true });
  addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    if (e.target.closest("a,button,input,summary,details,.card,.project-card,.feature,.contact")) return;
    ripples.push({ x: e.clientX * DPR, y: e.clientY * DPR, t0: performance.now() });
  });
  document.getElementById("themeBtn").addEventListener("click", () => { P = document.body.classList.contains("light") ? PALETTES.light : PALETTES.dark; });

  resize(); addEventListener("resize", resize);
  if (sections[0]) activate(sections[0]);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* ===== Academic journey map + project views (Cards / Map / Connections) ===== */
(() => {
  const reduceMotion = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const hasL = typeof L !== "undefined";
  const isLight = () => document.body.classList.contains("light");
  const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, reduceMotion ? 0 : ms));
  // Keyless basemaps (Esri), so the maps work on GitHub Pages and when the file is opened locally.
  const ESRI = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/";
  const BASEMAPS = {
    dark:  { url: ESRI + "Canvas/World_Dark_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", attr: "Tiles &copy; Esri &mdash; Esri, HERE, Garmin, &copy; OpenStreetMap contributors", max: 16 },
    light: { url: ESRI + "Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", attr: "Tiles &copy; Esri &mdash; Esri, HERE, Garmin, &copy; OpenStreetMap contributors", max: 16 },
    satellite: { url: ESRI + "World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", attr: "Tiles &copy; Esri &mdash; Source: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community", max: 18 }
  };
  const OSM = { url: "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", attr: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors', max: 19 };
  const maps = [];
  const layerFor = key => {
    const d = BASEMAPS[key];
    const t = L.tileLayer(d.url, { attribution: d.attr, maxZoom: 19, maxNativeZoom: d.max });
    let failed = 0; // if the Esri tiles can't be reached, fall back to OpenStreetMap
    t.on("tileerror", () => { if (++failed === 4) { t.setUrl(OSM.url); t.options.maxNativeZoom = OSM.max; } });
    return t;
  };
  function makeMap(el, opts = {}) {
    const m = L.map(el, Object.assign({ scrollWheelZoom: false, zoomControl: true, attributionControl: true }, opts));
    m._layers2 = { Map: layerFor(isLight() ? "light" : "dark"), Satellite: layerFor("satellite") };
    m._layers2.Map.addTo(m); m._base = m._layers2.Map;
    L.control.layers(m._layers2, null, { position: "topright" }).addTo(m);
    maps.push(m); return m;
  }
  document.getElementById("themeBtn").addEventListener("click", () => maps.forEach(m => m._layers2.Map.setUrl(BASEMAPS[isLight() ? "light" : "dark"].url)));

  // quadratic arc between two lat/lng points
  function arc(a, b, n = 64, bend = .22) {
    const cx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2 - (b[1] - a[1]) * bend, cy = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + (b[0] - a[0]) * bend, pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const t = i / n, u = 1 - t; pts.push([u * u * a[0] + 2 * u * t * cx + t * t * b[0], u * u * a[1] + 2 * u * t * cy + t * t * b[1]]); }
    return pts;
  }
  const escapeHtml = s => s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));

  /* ---------------- 1. Academic journey map ---------------- */
  // Coordinates are approximate (city / campus level).
  const STOPS = [
    { key: "bsc", n: 1, title: "B.Sc. Geography (Hons.)", place: "Kazi Nazrul University, Asansol, West Bengal", when: "2022–2025", ll: [23.683, 86.975], zoom: 9 },
    { key: "msc", n: 2, title: "M.Sc. Geoinformatics", place: "BVIEER, Bharati Vidyapeeth, Pune", when: "Current", ll: [18.4575, 73.8565], zoom: 12 },
    { key: "soi", n: 3, title: "Survey of India internship", place: "Maharashtra & Goa Geo-Spatial Directorate, Pune", when: "May – June 2026", ll: [18.5286, 73.8743], zoom: 12 },
    { key: "maval", n: 4, title: "Thesis field area", place: "Maval Taluka", when: "Thesis research", ll: [18.745, 73.64], zoom: 10 },
    { key: "mahabaleshwar", n: 5, title: "Thesis field area", place: "Mahabaleshwar", when: "Thesis research", ll: [17.9237, 73.6586], zoom: 10 }
  ];
  const jEl = document.getElementById("journeyMap"), playBtn = document.getElementById("playJourney");
  const listItems = [...document.querySelectorAll("#journeyList [data-stop]")];
  let jMap, jLayer, playing = false, journeyStarted = false;

  const stopIcon = (s, active) => L.divIcon({
    className: "", iconSize: [34, 34], iconAnchor: [17, 17],
    html: `<div class="jm${active ? " active" : ""}"><span>${s.n}</span></div>`
  });
  function markActive(key) {
    listItems.forEach(li => li.classList.toggle("active", li.dataset.stop.split(",").includes(key)));
  }
  function addStop(s, active) {
    const m = L.marker(s.ll, { icon: stopIcon(s, active), keyboard: true, title: s.place })
      .bindPopup(`<b>${s.title}</b><br>${s.place}<br><span class="pop-when">${s.when}</span>`)
      .on("click", () => markActive(s.key));
    m.addTo(jLayer); s.marker = m; return m;
  }
  function drawStatic() {
    jLayer.clearLayers();
    STOPS.forEach((s, i) => {
      if (i) L.polyline(arc(STOPS[i - 1].ll, s.ll), { className: "journey-line", weight: 2 }).addTo(jLayer);
      addStop(s, false);
    });
  }
  function animateArc(a, b, ms) {
    return new Promise(res => {
      const pts = arc(a, b), line = L.polyline([pts[0]], { className: "journey-line live", weight: 3 }).addTo(jLayer);
      const head = L.circleMarker(pts[0], { radius: 6, className: "journey-head" }).addTo(jLayer);
      if (reduceMotion) { line.setLatLngs(pts); head.remove(); return res(); }
      const t0 = performance.now();
      (function step(now) {
        const f = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / ms), k = Math.max(1, Math.round(f * (pts.length - 1)));
        line.setLatLngs(pts.slice(0, k + 1)); head.setLatLng(pts[k]);
        f < 1 ? requestAnimationFrame(step) : (head.remove(), res());
      })(t0);
    });
  }
  async function playJourney() {
    if (playing || !jMap) return; playing = true; playBtn.disabled = true; playBtn.textContent = "Playing…";
    jLayer.clearLayers(); jMap.closePopup();
    for (let i = 0; i < STOPS.length; i++) {
      const s = STOPS[i];
      if (i) {
        const prev = STOPS[i - 1];
        jMap.flyToBounds(L.latLngBounds([prev.ll, s.ll]).pad(.35), { duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 1.1, maxZoom: 10 });
        await wait(1150);
        await animateArc(prev.ll, s.ll, 1300);
      } else { jMap.flyTo(s.ll, 6, { duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 1.2 }); await wait(1250); }
      STOPS.forEach(o => o.marker && o.marker.setIcon(stopIcon(o, false)));
      addStop(s, true).openPopup(); markActive(s.key);
      await wait(1500);
    }
    jMap.closePopup();
    jMap.flyToBounds(L.latLngBounds(STOPS.map(s => s.ll)).pad(.15), { duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 1.2 });
    playing = false; playBtn.disabled = false; playBtn.textContent = "▶ Replay journey";
  }
  if (jEl) {
    if (!hasL) jEl.innerHTML = '<p class="note">The map could not load. Check your internet connection.</p>';
    else {
      jMap = makeMap(jEl); jLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(jMap);
      jMap.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(STOPS.map(s => s.ll)).pad(.15));
      drawStatic();
      playBtn.addEventListener("click", playJourney);
      listItems.forEach(li => {
        const go = () => {
          const s = STOPS.find(x => x.key === li.dataset.stop.split(",")[0]); if (!s || playing) return;
          if (!s.marker) drawStatic();
          jMap.flyTo(s.ll, s.zoom, { duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 1.2 }); markActive(s.key);
          setTimeout(() => s.marker.openPopup(), reduceMotion ? 0 : 1250);
        };
        li.addEventListener("click", go);
        li.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); go(); } });
      });
      // play automatically the first time the section comes into view
      new IntersectionObserver((es, obs) => es.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting && !journeyStarted) { journeyStarted = true; jMap.invalidateSize(); if (!reduceMotion) playJourney(); obs.disconnect(); }
      }), { threshold: .45 }).observe(jEl);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- 2. Project data from the cards ---------------- */
  const CATS = {
    gis: { label: "GIS", color: "#55e6ad" }, rs: { label: "Remote Sensing", color: "#39b6ff" },
    webgis: { label: "WebGIS", color: "#d5ff5b" }, geoai: { label: "GeoAI", color: "#c79bff" }, field: { label: "Fieldwork", color: "#ffb86b" }
  };
  // Approximate study-area locations; projects without a single site stay off the map.
  const GEO = {
    "NH-48 Pune–Mulshi LULC": [18.51, 73.70, "Pune–Mulshi highway corridor"],
    "Climate Justice & Flood Mapping": [26.2, 92.9, "Assam"],
    "Campus Food Mapping WebGIS": [18.4575, 73.8565, "BVIEER campus, Pune"],
    "Pashan Lake Monitoring": [18.5362, 73.7856, "Pashan Lake, Pune"],
    "Campus Tree Tagging": [18.4575, 73.8565, "BVIEER campus, Pune"],
    "Mulshi Environmental Fieldwork": [18.514, 73.513, "Mulshi"],
    "PostGIS Spatial Database": [18.4575, 73.8565, "BVIEER campus, Pune"],
    "GeoAI Rural Road Extraction": [18.745, 73.64, "Maval & Mahabaleshwar"],
    "Palamau Tiger Reserve StoryMap": [23.83, 84.18, "Palamau, Jharkhand"],
    "MODIS Vegetation State Statistics": [22.5, 79.0, "India-wide"],
    "Hyderabad LULC Explorer": [17.385, 78.4867, "Hyderabad"],
    "Maval Geospatial Explorer": [18.745, 73.64, "Maval Taluka"]
  };
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll("#projectGrid .project-card")];
  const projects = cards.map((card, i) => {
    const title = card.querySelector("h3").textContent.trim();
    const linkEl = card.querySelector("a.project-link");
    return {
      i, card, title, desc: card.querySelector("p").textContent.trim(),
      tags: [...card.querySelectorAll(".tag")].map(t => t.textContent.trim()),
      cats: card.dataset.cat.split(/\s+/).filter(c => CATS[c]),
      link: linkEl ? linkEl.href : null, geo: GEO[title] || null
    };
  });
  const visible = p => !p.card.classList.contains("hidden");

  /* ---------------- 3. View switching ---------------- */
  const panels = { cards: document.getElementById("projectGrid"), map: document.getElementById("projectMapView"), network: document.getElementById("projectNetView") };
  let view = "cards";
  document.querySelectorAll("#viewSwitch button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    view = b.dataset.view;
    document.querySelectorAll("#viewSwitch button").forEach(x => { x.classList.toggle("active", x === b); x.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(x === b)); });
    for (const k in panels) panels[k].classList.toggle("view-off", k !== view);
    if (view === "map") openProjectMap();
    if (view === "network") openNetwork();
    refresh();
  }));
  // hook into existing search + filters
  document.getElementById("projectSearch").addEventListener("input", () => setTimeout(refresh));
  document.querySelectorAll(".filter").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => setTimeout(refresh)));

  /* ---------------- 4. Project map view ---------------- */
  let pMap, pMarkers = [], mapBuilt = false;
  const HOME = [18.4575, 73.8565];
  function openProjectMap() {
    const el = document.getElementById("projectMap");
    if (!hasL) { el.innerHTML = '<p class="note">The map could not load. Check your internet connection.</p>'; return; }
    if (!pMap) pMap = makeMap(el);
    pMap.invalidateSize();
    if (mapBuilt) return; mapBuilt = true;
    const mapped = projects.filter(p => p.geo);
    pMap.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(mapped.map(p => [p.geo[0], p.geo[1]])).pad(.12));
    // spread projects that share a location in a small ring
    const groups = {};
    mapped.forEach(p => (groups[p.geo[0] + "," + p.geo[1]] ||= []).push(p));
    Object.values(groups).forEach(g => g.forEach((p, k) => {
      const r = g.length > 1 ? .012 : 0, a = k / g.length * Math.PI * 2;
      p.ll = [p.geo[0] + Math.sin(a) * r, p.geo[1] + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.2];
    }));
    mapped.forEach((p, k) => setTimeout(() => {
      const color = CATS[p.cats[0]]?.color || "#55e6ad";
      const far = Math.abs(p.ll[0] - HOME[0]) + Math.abs(p.ll[1] - HOME[1]) > .08;
      if (far) L.polyline(arc(HOME, p.ll, 48, .18), { className: "flow-line", weight: 1.6, color }).addTo(pMap);
      const m = L.marker(p.ll, {
        title: p.title, riseOnHover: true,
        icon: L.divIcon({ className: "", iconSize: [22, 22], iconAnchor: [11, 11], html: `<div class="pm" style="--c:${color}"></div>` })
      }).addTo(pMap).bindPopup(
        `<b>${escapeHtml(p.title)}</b><br><span class="pop-when">${escapeHtml(p.geo[2])}</span><p>${escapeHtml(p.desc)}</p>` +
        (p.link ? `<a href="${p.link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open project ↗</a>` : `<span class="pop-when">Academic work</span>`),
        { maxWidth: 280 });
      m.project = p; pMarkers.push(m); refresh();
    }, reduceMotion ? 0 : 140 * k));
    const off = projects.filter(p => !p.geo).map(p => p.title);
    document.getElementById("unmapped").textContent = off.length ? "Not tied to one study area: " + off.join(" • ") : "";
  }

  /* ---------------- 5. Connections (force graph) view ---------------- */
  const cv = document.getElementById("netCanvas"), cx = cv.getContext("2d"), info = document.getElementById("netInfo");
  const DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  let nodes = [], edges = [], netRunning = false, hover = null, selected = null, drag = null, CW = 0, CH = 0, t0 = performance.now();
  (function buildGraph() {
    const hubs = {};
    const hub = (id, label, type, color) => hubs[id] ||= { id, label, type, color, r: type === "c" ? 15 : 5, links: 0 };
    for (const c in CATS) hub("c:" + c, CATS[c].label, "c", CATS[c].color);
    const catLabels = Object.values(CATS).map(c => c.label.toLowerCase());
    const tagCount = {};
    const ALIAS = { gee: "google earth engine" };
    const key = t => ALIAS[t.toLowerCase()] || t.toLowerCase();
    projects.forEach(p => p.tags.forEach(t => { const k = key(t); if (!catLabels.includes(k)) tagCount[k] = (tagCount[k] || 0) + 1; }));
    projects.forEach(p => {
      const n = { id: "p:" + p.i, label: p.title, type: "p", color: CATS[p.cats[0]]?.color || "#55e6ad", r: 8, project: p };
      nodes.push(n); p.node = n;
      p.cats.forEach(c => edges.push({ a: n, b: hubs["c:" + c], len: 175, ph: Math.random() }));
      p.tags.forEach(t => {
        const k = key(t);
        if (tagCount[k] >= 2) { const h = hub("t:" + k, k === "google earth engine" ? "Google Earth Engine" : t, "t", "#a9c2b9"); edges.push({ a: n, b: h, len: 110, ph: Math.random() }); }
      });
    });
    nodes.push(...Object.values(hubs));
  })();
  const neighbours = n => new Set(edges.flatMap(e => e.a === n ? [e.b] : e.b === n ? [e.a] : []));

  function sizeCanvas() {
    const w = cv.parentElement.clientWidth, h = innerWidth < 650 ? 460 : 580;
    CW = w * DPR; CH = h * DPR; cv.width = CW; cv.height = CH; cv.style.width = w + "px"; cv.style.height = h + "px";
    // anchor the five field hubs on an ellipse so the network fills the panel
    nodes.filter(n => n.type === "c").forEach((n, i, arr) => { const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i / arr.length * Math.PI * 2; n.ax = CW / 2 + Math.cos(a) * CW * .36; n.ay = CH / 2 + Math.sin(a) * CH * .34; });
  }
  function openNetwork() {
    sizeCanvas();
    if (!nodes[0].x) nodes.forEach(n => { const a = Math.random() * 6.283; n.x = CW / 2 + Math.cos(a) * 20; n.y = CH / 2 + Math.sin(a) * 20; n.vx = n.vy = 0; });
    if (!netRunning) { netRunning = true; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
  }
  function physics() {
    const s = DPR;
    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
      const a = nodes[i], b = nodes[j]; let dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y, d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + .01;
      const f = (a.type === "c" || b.type === "c" ? 16000 : 7000) * s * s / d2, d = Math.sqrt(d2);
      dx /= d; dy /= d; a.vx -= dx * f / 60; a.vy -= dy * f / 60; b.vx += dx * f / 60; b.vy += dy * f / 60;
    }
    for (const e of edges) {
      const dx = e.b.x - e.a.x, dy = e.b.y - e.a.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, f = (d - e.len * s) * .012;
      e.a.vx += dx / d * f; e.a.vy += dy / d * f; e.b.vx -= dx / d * f; e.b.vy -= dy / d * f;
    }
    for (const n of nodes) {
      if (n === drag) { n.vx = n.vy = 0; continue; }
      if (n.ax) { n.vx += (n.ax - n.x) * .03; n.vy += (n.ay - n.y) * .03; }
      else { n.vx += (CW / 2 - n.x) * .0008; n.vy += (CH / 2 - n.y) * .0008; }
      n.vx *= .82; n.vy *= .82; n.x += n.vx; n.y += n.vy;
      const m = 30 * s; n.x = Math.max(m, Math.min(CW - m, n.x)); n.y = Math.max(m, Math.min(CH - m, n.y));
    }
  }
  function tick(now) {
    if (view !== "network") { netRunning = false; return; }
    physics();
    const t = (now - t0) / 1000, light = isLight(), s = DPR;
    const focus = selected || hover, near = focus ? neighbours(focus) : null;
    cx.clearRect(0, 0, CW, CH);
    for (const e of edges) {
      const on = focus && (e.a === focus || e.b === focus), dim = !visible(e.a.project);
      const al = dim ? .05 : on ? .75 : focus ? .06 : .2;
      cx.strokeStyle = hexA(e.b.type === "c" ? e.b.color : e.a.color, al); cx.lineWidth = (on ? 2 : 1) * s;
      cx.beginPath(); cx.moveTo(e.a.x, e.a.y); cx.lineTo(e.b.x, e.b.y); cx.stroke();
      if (!dim && (on || !focus)) { // data pulses travelling along each connection
        const u = (t * (on ? .6 : .25) + e.ph) % 1;
        cx.fillStyle = hexA(e.b.type === "c" ? e.b.color : "#d5ff5b", on ? .95 : .55);
        cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(e.a.x + (e.b.x - e.a.x) * u, e.a.y + (e.b.y - e.a.y) * u, (on ? 2.6 : 1.6) * s, 0, 6.283); cx.fill();
      }
    }
    for (const n of nodes) {
      const dim = (n.type === "p" && !visible(n.project)) || (focus && n !== focus && !near.has(n));
      const pulse = n.type === "c" ? 1 + .08 * Math.sin(t * 2 + n.x) : 1, r = n.r * s * pulse * (n === focus ? 1.35 : 1);
      cx.globalAlpha = dim ? .18 : 1;
      if (n.type === "c") {
        cx.fillStyle = hexA(n.color, .18); cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(n.x, n.y, r * 1.9, 0, 6.283); cx.fill();
        cx.fillStyle = n.color; cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(n.x, n.y, r, 0, 6.283); cx.fill();
      } else if (n.type === "p") {
        cx.fillStyle = n.color; cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(n.x, n.y, r, 0, 6.283); cx.fill();
        cx.strokeStyle = light ? "#10231e" : "#06100e"; cx.lineWidth = 2 * s; cx.stroke();
      } else {
        cx.strokeStyle = light ? "#587068" : "#a9c2b9"; cx.lineWidth = 1.2 * s; cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(n.x, n.y, r, 0, 6.283); cx.stroke();
      }
      const showLabel = n.type !== "p" || n === focus || (near && near.has(n));
      if (showLabel && !(dim && n.type === "t")) {
        cx.font = `${n.type === "c" ? 600 : 500} ${(n.type === "c" ? 13 : 11) * s}px ${n.type === "t" ? '"DM Mono",monospace' : "Manrope,sans-serif"}`;
        cx.fillStyle = light ? "#10231e" : "#effcf6"; cx.textAlign = "center";
        cx.fillText(n.label, n.x, n.y - r - 7 * s);
      }
      cx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function hexA(hex, a) { const v = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16); return `rgba(${v >> 16},${v >> 8 & 255},${v & 255},${a})`; }
  function pick(e) {
    const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), x = (e.clientX - r.left) * DPR, y = (e.clientY - r.top) * DPR;
    let best = null, bd = 1e9;
    for (const n of nodes) { const d = Math.hypot(n.x - x, n.y - y); if (d < (n.r + 8) * DPR && d < bd) { best = n; bd = d; } }
    return { n: best, x, y };
  }
  let downAt = null;
  cv.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    const p = pick(e);
    if (drag) { drag.x = p.x; drag.y = p.y; return; }
    hover = p.n; cv.style.cursor = p.n ? "pointer" : "default";
  });
  cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { const p = pick(e); downAt = [e.clientX, e.clientY]; if (p.n) { drag = p.n; cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } });
  cv.addEventListener("pointerup", e => {
    const moved = downAt && Math.hypot(e.clientX - downAt[0], e.clientY - downAt[1]) > 5, n = drag; drag = null;
    if (moved) return;
    const target = n || pick(e).n;
    selected = target && target !== selected ? target : null;
    showInfo(selected);
  });
  cv.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { hover = null; });
  function showInfo(n) {
    if (!n) { info.innerHTML = "Click any dot to see what it connects to. Drag dots to rearrange the network."; return; }
    const near = [...neighbours(n)];
    if (n.type === "p") {
      const p = n.project;
      info.innerHTML = `<b>${escapeHtml(p.title)}</b><p>${escapeHtml(p.desc)}</p><div class="tags">${p.tags.map(t => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join("")}</div>` +
        (p.link ? `<a class="project-link" href="${p.link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open project ↗</a>` : "");
    } else {
      info.innerHTML = `<b>${escapeHtml(n.label)}</b><p class="muted">${near.length} project${near.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} use this:</p><div class="tags">${near.map(x => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(x.label)}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
    }
  }
  showInfo(null);
  addEventListener("resize", () => { if (view === "network") sizeCanvas(); });

  /* ---------------- 6. Keep views in sync with search + filters ---------------- */
  function refresh() {
    pMarkers.forEach(m => { const el = m.getElement(); if (el) el.classList.toggle("pm-dim", !visible(m.project)); });
    const nr = document.getElementById("noResults");
    if (view !== "cards") nr.style.display = "none";
    else nr.style.display = cards.some(visible) ? "none" : "block";
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
